adapters.name: flux_ofReal
adapters.reason: The Markov kernel gives real B-mass between zero and one, hence integrability under the finite restricted measure. The two indicator integrals reduce to the restricted real mass integral. Nonnegativity and finite kernel mass justify ofReal-integral conversion and pointwise ofReal_toReal recovery; no infinite-value cancellation is used.

adapters.name: reversible_of_bounded_pairing
adapters.reason: Measurable 0/1 indicators satisfy both unit bounds. Applying bounded pairing symmetry and the two flux conversions proves Mathlib's all-measurable-set IsReversible definition directly. There is no countability or singleton criterion.

adapters.name: pairing_eq_reference_average
adapters.reason: The bundled hF input is ((x,r),p),w and evaluates F r x p w, so the reference/input order is correct. Integrating the measurable bounded clock integrand gives measurable op. Probability laws bound op and f*op by one. The explicitly integrable product function supplies the q(input)-q(reference) Fubini swap, and each fixed-reference q-times-momentum section is separately measurable and bounded. The literal pushforward law is used before averaging. No uniform energy moment or integration over y is required.

adapters.name: reversible_of_reference_average
adapters.reason: Both sides use the same exact-law reference-average adapter; pointwise-in-reference duality gives equality of the outer integrals. Its generic internal symmetry argument is proved in the main theorem and is not an extra public leaf.

main_proof: The IdealHalfTurnKernel witness Z, R and H and all existing raw, good-path, initialization, exact-law and Markov outputs are reused unchanged.

Zb = Z is proved pointwise for every y, reference, phase point, time and clock sample. On a covered interval, the same record gives the same arc; an inr record contradicts the finite-time lower bound. Outside all covered intervals both raw fallback laws return the initial state. No almost-sure representative substitution or non-explosion argument is needed for this equality.

P probability is supplied by unit_exponential_product_laws.1; gamma probability is the standard Gaussian instance. For each y, q y probability is transported from the existing Markov R and its exact fiber equality R y = q y, not postulated. This delegates normalizer correctness to the existing ideal-kernel dependency.

The concrete hFM map inserts fixed y and t_pi and correctly assigns reference=r, initial state=(x,p), and the same clocks. The existing joint Z measurability, not only averaged H measurability, is used.

For each fixed y, kappa is exactly the comap section of the same H, and hKl is the retained exact returned-position pushforward under ((q y).prod gamma).prod P. The reference is independent of input position and of momentum/clocks.

After pointwise witness identification, imported bounded phase duality applies to position lifts. Both momentum flips disappear definitionally. The ring identity -(V+quadratic) = -V-quadratic identifies precisely the same normalized tilt q y.

The resulting detailed balance is for every y, not merely almost every y; all required finite-integrability and indicator conversion steps are internal. No new raw fallback, unspecified reversible kernel, or symmetry hypothesis is introduced.

source_alignment.conclusion: Matches the previously independently reviewed exact target. The implementation is the explicitly labelled bounded signed-test adapter: phase duality, position flip absorption, independent-reference averaging, then indicator fluxes. It is not presented as an implementation of the paper's self-adjoint position-L2-operator proof.
